verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions allow or block lists for emails, cards, devices or IPs. It also says nothing about velocity limits, or about managing either through the dashboard or an API. The only related item is that Decision Center policies can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, which is an adjacent policy feature rather than list or velocity management. The axis clearly applies to a fraud-protection product, so absent evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can maintain allow and block lists — emails, cards, devices, IPs — and velocity limits, managed through the dashboard and programmatically
